name: Axiom Discovery Call
description: Capture the prospect's workflow, volumes, tools, pains and next steps in their own words, for one-lane agent design.

sections.title: Company and People
sections.instruction: Company name, what it does, and every person named on the call with their role. Use only names and roles said in the transcript.

sections.title: Workflow Steps
sections.instruction: The current process step by step, in the order the prospect described it. For each step say who does it and which tool they use. Do not invent steps.

sections.title: Volumes and Timing
sections.instruction: Every number the prospect gave: calls, requests, jobs, leads, estimates per day, week or month; time taken; money amounts; percentages. Copy the numbers exactly as spoken.

sections.title: Tools and Systems
sections.instruction: Every software product, service, device or manual tool mentioned (for example CRM, phone system, spreadsheet, whiteboard, sticky notes).

sections.title: Pain Points
sections.instruction: Where the process breaks, what it costs, and the prospect's own evidence for it. One row per pain.

sections.title: Desired Outcome and Measure
sections.instruction: The one thing the prospect wants fixed and the number they would use to measure it.

sections.title: Decision Makers
sections.instruction: Who signs off and who else must be involved, as stated.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Agreed actions with owner and date or day, exactly as agreed on the call.
